title: 2002 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement: Right isosceles triangles are constructed on the sides of a \(3-4-5\) right triangle, as shown. A capital letter represents the area of each triangle. Which one of the following is true?

solutions.text:
For a right isosceles triangle built on a side of length \(s,\) the two legs have length \(s,\) so its area is \(\frac{s^2}{2}.\)

\[ \begin{aligned} &W=\frac{3\cdot4}{2}=6, \\ &\quad X=\frac{3^2}{2}=4.5, \\ &\quad Y=\frac{4^2}{2}=8, \\ &\quad Z=\frac{5^2}{2}=12.5. \end{aligned} \]

These values satisfy \(X+Y=Z,\) and the other listed equations do not.

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Each right isosceles triangle has area half the square of the side it is built on.
Compute the areas on the sides \(3,\) \(4,\) and \(5.\)
